title: Qwen3-4B BF16 on vLLM: single 24GB card
slug_note: The 8GB BF16 reference fits a 24GB card with most of the pool left for KV.

variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of Qwen/Qwen3-4B resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-25 test

engine.config: Stock vLLM serve at 32K; YaRN factor 4.0 for 128K

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25): 115.0 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need). That is vLLM's 0.9 reservation of the shared pool, not the model's minimum need. Earlier estimate: 8GB weights + KV; 128K YaRN context is the only thing that pressures a 24GB card here.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (630-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; vLLM default --gpu-memory-utilization (0.9), so this is the reservation, not the model's minimum need

caveats: Size computed from the HF API.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25), in vllm/vllm-openai:v0.32.0 with the HF cache mounted: server ready 200 s after `docker run` (weights from local disk, kernel autotune included); the functional check passed. 115.0 GiB dropped from MemAvailable is vLLM's default 0.9 reservation of the 128 GB pool, not the model's minimum need.
